title: The phone tests pass even if the 'put your gym on the home screen' pop-up never appears
what: Both phone flows that meet the pop-up after a join wait for it as optional and check it only when it happens to show. If the pop-up broke and never appeared, both flows would still pass. Its later screens ('Tap Add on your phone's question', 'Last step: remove the MettleUp icon', 'Not added') are never shown on a phone at all.
expected: For a gym with a logo the test should fail when the pop-up does not appear, and the add, last-step and not-added screens should each be seen once.
fix_line: Make the pop-up check required in the branded-gym flow and add one flow through each of its three later screens

title: The trainer's video row is never shown or tapped in any test
what: Tests check only which links count as YouTube and how a video is matched to an exercise. No test draws the 'Watch your trainer' row, taps it to open YouTube, shows 'Couldn't open the video' when offline, or checks that the row goes after the trainer removes the video or the member leaves the gym.
expected: A test should show the row on an exercise page, open the link outside the app, show the offline notice, and prove a removed video or an old gym's video is no longer offered.
fix_line: Add a screen test of the exercise page with and without a video, and a forget-on-leave check

title: 'Messaging your gym is not ready yet' is never tested
what: No test, word table or phone flow checks what the Message your gym page shows when the gym's server does not have messaging yet. The only related check is that the unread count is zero then.
expected: A test should show the 'not ready yet' words and no send box on a server without messaging.
fix_line: Add one check of the page on a server without messaging

title: The 'Recommend MettleUp to my gym' card is never checked to hide inside a gym or come back after leaving
what: Tests check only the link and that the card's words mention running a gym and free. Nothing checks the card's full words, that it is hidden for a member inside a MettleUp gym, that it returns after leaving, or that cancelling the share menu leaves the screen as it was.
expected: A test should show the card on the no-gym screen with its words, prove it is gone after a join and back after leaving, and that a cancelled share shows no error.
fix_line: Add the card to an existing no-gym phone flow and to a join-then-leave flow

title: No test proves the Gym tab home shows only this gym's data and sends nothing extra
what: Tests check the header's size and the parts' order. Nothing checks that the Gym tab home holds only the joined gym's public name, logo and parts, or what the phone sends to the gym when it checks that the member is still joined.
expected: A test should prove another gym's data never appears and the still-joined check sends only the member's own key.
fix_line: Add one check of what the still-joined call sends and one with two gyms' data

title: Find my gym is tested only with a made-up answer, never with the WhatsApp step
what: Every phone flow for Find my gym and phone sign-in uses the test build's made-up answer, so the WhatsApp message, 'Send the message in WhatsApp', 'Looking for your gym...', a wrong sending number, 'checked too many times today' and the time-out with the typed values kept are never seen on a phone. The card itself shows only when MettleUp Plus is switched on, which the store build has off. Several journey words ('We check your number against...', 'We look only for a plan that runs today...', 'may contact your gym') are asserted nowhere.
expected: At least the screens after each server answer should be drawn in a test, and the exact words the journeys promise should be checked once.
fix_line: Add a stand-in for each server answer (wrong number, too many, expired) and assert the promised words

title: Bring a friend's count is never checked to stay at 0 before a friend joins, or to go back down
what: The server test checks the count is 1 after the desk marks the friend joined. It never checks that a friend who only left a number leaves the count at 0, or that the count goes down when the join is undone. No test checks the share menu opens only once on a fast double tap.
expected: The server test should read the count after the friend's page is sent and after the join is undone; a phone check should tap Invite twice quickly.
fix_line: Add two count reads to the bring-a-friend server test and a double-tap check
